titulo: PlayStation Is Offering $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
texto: PlayStation is offering $40 off when you buy a refurbished PS5 console and DualSense controller together, delivering up to $155 in total savings.

titulo: GTA 6 Burgers Will Be Available In Florida Throughout The Year
texto: Rockstar Games and the burger company Skinny Louie have announced a partnership to promote GTA 6 , during which its stores will convert to Burger Shots through the end of the year. Burger Shot is the Burger King parody in the world of GTA. People in South Florida can buy GTA 6 burgers at the Kaseya Center, and also every Skinny Louie location in Florida starting in early November. The campaign runs through December 31. The Burger Shot locations will serve a menu "straight out of Vice City"--and this includes smash burgers, fries, and drinks. People in South Florida can buy the GTA 6 burgers in store or have them delivered. In addition to Burger Shot, GTA's Cluckin' Bell fried chicken store is available IRL at the Kaseya Center. titulo: GTA 6’s New TV Trailer Is A Bit Different, See It For Yourself
texto: GTA 6 's marketing push is ramping up substantially, and that includes with TV commercials. Eagled-eyes fans have discovered that the new GTA 6 TV spots actually contain some extended sequences, but just barely. For starters, a 30-second TV spot cuts out the steamy shower scenes with Jason and Lucia from the launch trailer . While the shower scenes are gone in this edit, the new TV spot has a slightly longer shots of an airplane sequence and another with Jason and Lucia standing next to their car. Jason playfully nudges Lucia, and in the TV spot, she nearly topples to the ground. The Xbox logo was also removed, presumably due to Rockstar's reported promotional deal with Sony.
